description: Lists the items that are prohibited or restricted when posting from Sri Lanka to a destination country by international mail. Returns every entry for the country; compare the user's item against the descriptions yourself, as wording varies ("lithium batteries" vs "power banks"). Absence from the list is not a guarantee that an item is allowed.

country.description: Destination country, as an English name ("Australia") or two-letter ISO code ("AU").

name: check-prohibited-articles
title: Check prohibited articles
